title: Clinical Trial IND Safety Reporting Coordinator
tagline: Serious is not enough, unexpected is not enough, and a fatal event does not automatically prove causality.

cards: A trial participant had a serious event
Severity alone appears to determine rapid reporting.
Qualified review changes whether and when the IND path applies.
Report every SAE the same way
Noise can obscure signals while a fatal qualifying case inherits the slower clock.
The coordinator supports safety owners without practicing medicine.

story.headline: The fatal event placed on the fifteen-day calendar
beats: A sponsor receives a fatal unexpected event from an investigator.
Qualified review identifies a suspected relationship to the investigational drug.
The agent transfers the familiar fifteen-day serious-event route.
The safety graph selects seven days, preserves medical authority, and opens follow-up receipts.
